name: Da Lat Education College
kicker: Colonnade and bell tower on Yersin
summary: The education college on Yersin is a street view: the curved colonnade and the bell tower from the gate. It is free from the pavement. Fifteen minutes is enough. Do not walk into exam halls during term. Interior permission is not a visitor ticket.

notice.title: Stay at the gate
notice.body: The visit is the colonnade and the bell tower from the street. Exam halls are not a public walk during term.

body: On Yersin, stop at the gate for the curved colonnade and the bell tower. Vietnam Tourism includes the college among the hill-station buildings you see from the street. Fifteen minutes is the outside look.
It is free from the pavement. There is no printed visitor hour. Interior hours are Check on arrival. Do not treat a term-time exam hall as part of the walk.

figures.caption: The bell tower above the colonnade
figures.alt: Bell tower of Da Lat Education College

gettingThere: The college faces Yersin. Walk from the lake side of town along that street. A door number and a minute count are not printed. Check on arrival.
